cues.text: In Hagakure, the ramen shop at the Iwatodai strip mall, Shinjiro sits alone at the counter eating from a bowl. Akihiko walks in and sits down one stool away from him.
The server sets a steaming bowl in front of Akihiko, and he starts to eat.
Shinjiro puts down his bowl, gets up from his stool and walks out behind Akihiko, leaving the empty bowl on the counter.
